Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS|FAIL","findings":[{"id":"F1","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"quote the exact code","fix":"..."}],"confidence":0.0}. If you cannot quote the code that proves a finding, do not report it.

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 87 CYCLE 2 (verification of the final diff) = RULING 106 (b) on the REVIEW path (orchestrator 2026-11-14 '20:21'): "a finished video that passes every gate is always launched and delivered as a candidate; one open integrity point means the REVIEW path with that point in the caption, never left unrendered." With RULING 93 AS AMENDED ('21:10'): a clip whose source-burned captions the 9:16 crop cuts mid-word is 16:9-only. The case (tonight): run pinned_20261115_013448 (Blockware spotlight 3f481f5a): the 16:9 final cleared every one of its 24 gate rows; its 9:16 crop cuts the source's burned captions ('SOLD MY' reads 'D MY'); the run's EDL predates the sealed 'formats' field (absent = both). On re-judgment the builder's L-s step A refused the moment (CONDITION_OUTSIDE, REFERENT_OUTSIDE). telegram.review_drop, an engineering REVIEW to the approval chat (head "REVIEW ONLY - NOT A PASS - not for publishing"; never a release authorisation; texts generated in code, the caller could not edit them), would send BOTH finals and could not state the open point. The change: review_drop(run_dir, send=None, withhold=None, points=()). withhold {format: reason}: formats of this run NOT read or sent, each with a non-empty reason; a format outside the run's formats or a blank reason -> STOP; withholding every format -> STOP. points: caller-stated open integrity points, non-empty strings <= REVIEW_POINT_MAX (300). Only the formats sent are judged (review_nonpass of those formats, unchanged otherwise; the REVIEW_NOT_DROPPABLE rule unchanged for them). review_texts puts "OPEN INTEGRITY POINT:

" and "WITHHELD, NOT SENT: : " lines right under the head of every caption and of the note (the caption is cut from the END by _fit, unchanged); every text then passes the unchanged checks (starts with the head; _review_forbidden: no PASS / PASSED, CANDIDATE FOR APPROVAL, approved, outside the head) AND each stated line must appear WHOLE as a line in every text, else STOP. SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY ("the package sealed formats ['16x9']") is now printed only when the EDL SEALS 16:9 alone (release_auth.release_formats), never for a caller's withhold. REVIEW_DROP.json records 'withheld' and 'points'. Nothing else changes: no release path, no attestation, no ledger. Tests (test_review_drop, 3 new): the 9:16 withheld (its file deleted first: never read) and a point stated: only the 16:9 is sent, the point and the withheld reason ride whole under the head of the caption and the note, before the 'Not passing' line, recorded in REVIEW_DROP.json, and the 9:16's content-integrity failure (G16 FAIL) does not block the 16:9 drop; MUST-FAIL mirror: without withhold both finals go and no point line exists; refusals, nothing sent and no REVIEW_DROP.json: an unknown format, a blank reason, every format withheld, an empty / too long / non-string point, a point with 'passed', four 300-character points that cannot fit whole in a 1024-character caption. 25 + 24 (delivery) pass; on the old code (c396c3c8) the 3 new tests fail. Cycle 1 (qwen27b PASS 0.85, glm PASS 0.85, no consensus): glm's low note (a withheld reason had no length cap; it failed closed via the whole-line check) is closed: a withheld reason is now capped at REVIEW_POINT_MAX like a point, with a refusal test. FIND: a way for a caller to make the drop look like a pass, a release or an approval; a withheld format still read or sent; a stated point cut, dropped or hidden from any caption; a content-integrity failure of a SENT format that no longer blocks; any change for a caller that passes neither withhold nor points. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings. The caller states each point and may withhold a format (with its reason); it can only ADD these lines. +REVIEW_POINT_HEAD = "OPEN INTEGRITY POINT: " +WITHHELD_HEAD = "WITHHELD, NOT SENT: " +REVIEW_POINT_MAX = 300 # content-integrity rows: a run that fails any of them is never dropped, not even for review. V1 (two vision models) # is droppable ONLY when every failing V1 item is a SPLIT (one model yes, one no; ruling 23 '13:18'); both-no, a # missing answer, or a failing credits item whose measured ring geometry (G15_credits, DEC-11) is not PASS refuse. @@ -660,10 +665,12 @@ def review_nonpass(run_dir, formats=None): return out -def review_texts(run_dir, nonpass, digests): +def review_texts(run_dir, nonpass, digests, withheld=None, points=()): """The video captions and the review note, generated here and nowhere else (the caller cannot edit them): the head first, then every non-pass REQUIRED row, the files' sha256, run id, HEAD, title, caption, the - per-clip source links and the deviations.""" + per-clip source links and the deviations. The caller may only ADD (ruling 106 (b)): the open integrity points + it states and the formats it withholds with their reasons, both right under the head, in every caption.""" + import release_auth with open(os.path.join(run_dir, "edl.json")) as f: edl = json.load(f) head = "" @@ -675,15 +682,18 @@ def review_texts(run_dir, nonpass, digests): pass run_id = os.path.basename(os.path.abspath(run_dir).rstrip("/")) rows = ", ".join(sorted({f"{k} {v}" for _, k, v, _ in nonpass})) or "none" - only = list(digests) == ["16x9"] # ruling 93 as amended: the drop carries exactly the sealed formats - caps = {fmt: _fit(f"{REVIEW_HEAD}\nNot passing (required): {rows}\nrun {run_id} | {fmt} sha256 {digests[fmt]}" - + (f"\n{SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY}" if only else "") + only = release_auth.release_formats(edl) == ("16x9",) # ruling 93 as amended: the package SEALED 16:9 only + added = [f"{REVIEW_POINT_HEAD}{p}" for p in points] + \ + [f"{WITHHELD_HEAD}{fmt.replace('x', ':')}: {why}" for fmt, why in (withheld or {}).items()] + caps = {fmt: _fit("\n".join([REVIEW_HEAD] + added) + f"\nNot passing (required): {rows}\nrun {run_id} | " + f"{fmt} sha256 {digests[fmt]}" + (f"\n{SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY}" if only else "") + "\nReasons, links and deviations: the review note in this chat.", CAPTION_MAX) for fmt in digests} segs = [("hook", edl.get("hook") or {})] + [(f"clip {c.get('index', i + 1)}", c) for i, c in enumerate(edl.get("clips") or [])] links = edl.get("moments_sources_30s_before") or [] - lines = [REVIEW_HEAD, "", "Required rows NOT passing (verbatim, with the measured reason):"] + lines = [REVIEW_HEAD, ""] + ([*added, ""] if added else []) + \ + ["Required rows NOT passing (verbatim, with the measured reason):"] lines += [f"- {fmt} {k} {v}: {why}" for fmt, k, v, why in nonpass] or ["- none"] lines += ["", f"Run {run_id} | HEAD {head or 'not recorded'}"] lines += [f"{fmt.replace('x', ':')} sha256 {digests[fmt]}" for fmt in digests] + ([SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY] if only else []) @@ -724,18 +734,32 @@ def review_texts(run_dir, nonpass, digests): return caps, "\n".join(lines) -def review_drop(run_dir, send=None): +def review_drop(run_dir, send=None, withhold=None, points=()): """Send a run that is NOT authorised for release to the approval chat as an engineering REVIEW (order '13:06'): the finals of the formats its EDL seals (both when none; ruling 93 as amended) + the review note. - Refuses (nothing sent) without GATE_REPORT.json or readable formats, when a + withhold {format: reason}: formats of this run NOT sent, each with its stated reason (at least one format stays). + points: the open integrity points the caller states (ruling 106 (b): each in every caption and the note; at most + REVIEW_POINT_MAX characters each). Both can only ADD lines and pass the same wording check. Only the formats sent + are judged. Refuses (nothing sent) without GATE_REPORT.json or readable formats, when a content-integrity row (REVIEW_NOT_DROPPABLE) is not PASS, when any text would carry PASS-as-verdict wording, - 'CANDIDATE FOR APPROVAL' or 'approved', or when this run was already review-dropped. Writes REVIEW_DROP.json + 'CANDIDATE FOR APPROVAL' or 'approved', when a stated point or withheld reason does not fit whole in every caption, + or when this run was already review-dropped. Writes REVIEW_DROP.json (what was sent, to which chat, the message ids). Never writes or reads the release ledger.""" import hashlib send = send or _send_bot_api if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(run_dir, "GATE_REPORT.json")): raise RuntimeError("STOP: review drop: no GATE_REPORT.json for this run") formats = review_formats(run_dir) # ruling 93 as amended: the sealed formats ALONE + withhold, points = dict(withhold or {}), list(points or ()) + if any(f not in formats or not (isinstance(r, str) and r.strip() and len(r) <= REVIEW_POINT_MAX) + for f, r in withhold.items()): + raise RuntimeError(f"STOP: review drop: withhold names a format outside {list(formats)} or gives no reason " + f"(<= {REVIEW_POINT_MAX} characters)") + if not all(isinstance(p, str) and p.strip() and len(p) <= REVIEW_POINT_MAX for p in points): + raise RuntimeError(f"STOP: review drop: each open point must be a non-empty string <= {REVIEW_POINT_MAX}") + formats = tuple(f for f in formats if f not in withhold) + if not formats: + raise RuntimeError("STOP: review drop: every format withheld; nothing to send") nonpass = review_nonpass(run_dir, formats) with open(os.path.join(run_dir, "GATE_REPORT.json")) as f: rep_rows = json.load(f).get("rows") or {} @@ -764,17 +788,22 @@ def review_drop(run_dir, send=None): with open(p, "rb") as f: payload[fmt] = f.read() # read once; exactly these bytes are hashed and sent digests[fmt] = hashlib.sha256(payload[fmt]).hexdigest() - caps, note = review_texts(run_dir, nonpass, digests) + caps, note = review_texts(run_dir, nonpass, digests, withheld=withhold, points=points) + need = [REVIEW_POINT_HEAD + p for p in points] + \ + [f"{WITHHELD_HEAD}{f.replace('x', ':')}: {r}" for f, r in withhold.items()] for t in list(caps.values()) + [note]: if not t.startswith(REVIEW_HEAD): raise RuntimeError("STOP: review drop text does not begin with the review head") bad = _review_forbidden(t) if bad: raise RuntimeError(f"STOP: review drop refused: forbidden wording {sorted(set(bad))}") + if not set(need) <= set(t.split("\n")): # each stated line WHOLE, as a line (never cut by _fit) + raise RuntimeError("STOP: review drop: a stated point or withheld reason does not fit whole in every text") if len(note) > TEXT_MAX: raise RuntimeError(f"STOP: review note is {len(note)} characters > {TEXT_MAX}") rec = {"kind": "review_drop", "label": REVIEW_HEAD, "rule": "orchestrator order 2026-11-12 '13:06'", "chat": "the approval chat (TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID)", "nonpass": [list(x) for x in nonpass], + "withheld": withhold, "points": points, "sha256": digests, "texts": {"captions": caps, "note": note}, "messages": []} try: for fmt in formats: diff --git a/pipeline/test_review_drop.py b/pipeline/test_review_drop.py index 49a0098e..32790a3e 100644 --- a/pipeline/test_review_drop.py +++ b/pipeline/test_review_drop.py @@ -108,6 +108,55 @@ class TestReviewDrop(unittest.TestCase): self._write("edl.json", self.edl) self._refused("formats are unreadable") + POINT = ("L-s step A refused the moment on re-judgment (Grok, 22:07 ET): CONDITION_OUTSIDE, 'by 45' rests on " + "~20% returns said after the clip; REFERENT_OUTSIDE, 'now'.") + WHY9 = "ruling 93 as amended: the 9:16 crop cuts the source's burned captions mid-word" + + def test_ruling_106_b_a_withheld_format_and_a_stated_point_ride_in_every_text(self): + """Ruling 106 (b): the REVIEW path carries the open integrity point in the caption; a format the integrator + withholds (ruling 93 as amended) is never read or sent, and its reason is stated. Only the sent format is + judged (the 9:16's content-integrity failure does not block a 16:9 drop). Must-fail: with no withhold the + same run sends both finals and no point line exists.""" + self.report["rows"]["9x16"]["G16_sentence_boundary"] = "FAIL" + self._write("GATE_REPORT.json", self.report) + os.remove(os.path.join(self.run, "out", "segment_vertical.mp4")) + rec = T.review_drop(self.run, send=self._send, withhold={"9x16": self.WHY9}, points=[self.POINT]) + vids = [s for s in self.sent if s[0] == "video"] + self.assertEqual([os.path.basename(s[1]) for s in vids], ["segment.mp4"]) + cap, note = vids[0][2]["caption"], self.sent[-1][2]["text"] + for t in (cap, note): + self.assertTrue(t.startswith(T.REVIEW_HEAD), t) + self.assertIn(T.REVIEW_POINT_HEAD + self.POINT, t) + self.assertIn(T.WITHHELD_HEAD + "9:16: " + self.WHY9, t) + self.assertLess(cap.index(self.POINT), cap.index("Not passing")) # under the head, never trimmed away + self.assertNotIn("9:16 sha256", note) + self.assertEqual((rec["withheld"], rec["points"]), ({"9x16": self.WHY9}, [self.POINT])) + self.assertEqual({x[0] for x in rec["nonpass"]}, {"16x9"}) + self.assertNotIn(T.SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY, note) # not sealed: withheld, said so + + def test_ruling_106_b_must_fail_without_withhold_both_go_and_no_point_line(self): + rec = T.review_drop(self.run, send=self._send) + self.assertEqual([os.path.basename(s[1]) for s in self.sent if s[0] == "video"], + ["segment.mp4", "segment_vertical.mp4"]) + self.assertNotIn(T.REVIEW_POINT_HEAD, self.sent[-1][2]["text"]) + self.assertEqual((rec["withheld"], rec["points"]), ({}, [])) + + def test_ruling_106_b_bad_withholds_and_points_send_nothing(self): + for kw, pattern in (({"withhold": {"1x1": "x"}}, "withhold names a format"), + ({"withhold": {"9x16": " "}}, "withhold names a format"), + ({"withhold": {"9x16": "x" * (T.REVIEW_POINT_MAX + 1)}}, "withhold names a format"), + ({"withhold": {"9x16": "a", "16x9": "b"}}, "every format withheld"), + ({"points": [""]}, "each open point"), + ({"points": ["x" * (T.REVIEW_POINT_MAX + 1)]}, "each open point"), + ({"points": [7]}, "each open point"), + ({"points": ["an earlier verdict passed it"]}, "forbidden wording"), + ({"points": [c * T.REVIEW_POINT_MAX for c in "wxyz"]}, "does not fit whole")): + with self.subTest(kw=kw): + with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, pattern): + T.review_drop(self.run, send=self._send, **kw) + self.assertEqual(self.sent, []) + self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(os.path.join(self.run, "REVIEW_DROP.json"))) + def test_without_a_gate_report_nothing_is_sent(self): os.remove(os.path.join(self.run, "GATE_REPORT.json")) self._refused("no GATE_REPORT.json")
